title: The ZK Powerball
tagline: The ZK Powerball is a scalable, secure, lottery game platform that offers Powerball and scratch off inspired lotteries.
description: The ZK Powerball is a scalable, secure, lottery game platform that offers Powerball and scratch off inspired lotteries. To promote fault tolerance and communication between chains ZK Powerball deploys contracts to Polygon, Gnosis, and Scroll in addition to Ethereum. Uses ZK Rollups to chose a winning number and then find the user wallet that contains it. A push notification is then sent to that user. This project is open source.
how_its_made:
The ZK Powerball is lottery game platform that offers Powerball and scratch. The features are as follows:

1. Powerball lottery choosing 6 2 digit numbers for a jackpot.
2. Scratch off lotteries that instantly pay out if won
3. Push notifications to users who have won the powerball

We implement rollups and cross chain communication to provide a smooth user experience.
